name: Xcode DerivedData
detail: Build intermediates and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them on the next build.

name: iOS device support files
detail: Debug symbols copied from connected devices. Xcode copies them again when a device is connected.

name: App caches
detail: Temporary data apps keep to speed things up. Apps recreate it when needed.

name: Package manager caches
detail: Downloaded packages for npm, pnpm, Gradle and Cargo. Re-downloaded on the next install.

name: Old node_modules
detail: Dependencies of projects untouched for 90 days. Run your package manager's install to restore them.

name: Installers
detail: Disk images and installer packages in Downloads.

name: Old downloads
detail: Files in Downloads not modified for 30 days.

name: Old Xcode archives
detail: App archives older than 180 days. They contain debug symbols needed to read old crash reports.

name: Old iPhone and iPad backups
detail: Device backups not updated for 180 days. Make sure you no longer need them.
